about.title: Baldwin Park Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Baldwin Park recorded four traffic deaths in 2025, alongside 406 injury collisions that hurt 584 people. Behind each of those numbers is a household on Ramona Boulevard, Baldwin Park Boulevard, or Francisquito Avenue that suddenly has an empty chair at the table. The I-10 San Bernardino Freeway also runs through the middle of town and carries a heavy share of local collision reports. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California gives surviving family members. It is separate from any criminal charges the Los Angeles County District Attorney may file, and it moves on its own timeline. Under state law, a spouse or domestic partner and children hold the first right to bring the claim; certain dependents and heirs may follow when those relatives are absent. The action can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for the lost love, companionship and guidance that no receipt can capture. Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks sharply when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Our team handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless we recover for your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Baldwin Park Families Choose Us

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children. We can sort out who in your family holds that right before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines tracked from day one
items.desc: Two years from the date of death is the general rule, but a claim against a public agency comes with a much shorter clock. Acting early protects your options.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: We work on contingency, meaning no upfront costs. Your family should not have to weigh legal bills against groceries during a loss.

items.question: The crash that killed my relative happened on the I-10 through Baldwin Park. Does that change the claim?
items.answer: Freeway cases can bring in additional parties, such as a trucking company or a public agency responsible for the roadway. If a government entity may be at fault, California requires a formal claim within a far shorter period than the usual two years. We can review the collision report and identify who needs to be put on notice, and how quickly.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Los Angeles County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death action is a civil matter and proceeds independently of any criminal prosecution. The criminal case is about punishment; the civil case is about your family's losses. We can decide whether it makes sense to move forward now or coordinate timing with the criminal proceedings.

items.question: What losses can our family actually recover in a California wrongful death case?
items.answer: State law allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have contributed over their expected lifetime, and the loss of love, companionship, comfort, and guidance. Each family's circumstances are different, so no one can tell you in advance what a case is worth. We will evaluate your specific situation honestly.
